summary: A superb three bedroomed detached bungalow situated in the popular Village of Great Orton. The bungalow sits on a generous plot with driveway parking, garage and separate outbuilding. Great Orton hosts its own pub, popular butchers shop and local primary school.
description:
The property is approached by a sweeping driveway with enough room for three cars, and a single garage with up and over door. Entrance hall with storage cupboards leading to a fantastic lounge/ dining room. This room benefits from large windows on three sides of the room flooding the space with light. At the opposite end of the room is a log burning stove providing a cosy feeling in the winter months. The perfect balance. Just off the lounge is a modern kitchen with appliances including electric oven and hob. To the rear of the property is a useful utility room with plumbing for a washing machine and/or tumble dryer, and a contemporary shower room, perfect a busy family. To the rear of the property is a private and low maintenance patio area and a lawned garden with gated access to the side of the property. Alongside the garden is a large outbuilding providing the perfect storage area. The bungalow also has a three piece family bathroom with shower over bath and two double bedrooms and one large single bedroom. Each bedroom is tastefully decorated and carpeted. Equally the bungalow offers the versatility to use one of these rooms as a home office. A lovely home in a popular village with excellent access to Carlisle, and the West of Carlisle alike. Monthly window cleaning and gardener to cut the grass and maintain the garden on a regular basis included. Oil fired heating and double glazing throughout.

Services Mains Water, Electricity and Oil fired heating.
